contentEn:
Whole house renovation in Vancouver costs $23,000 to over $400,000 in 2026, depending on scope and neighbourhood. Reno Stars has completed whole-house projects across Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, Langley, North Vancouver and Delta. This guide gives real budget ranges drawn from those completed projects.

What Does a Whole House Renovation Cost in Vancouver in 2026?

A full whole house renovation — replacing kitchens, bathrooms, flooring and core systems throughout a home — starts at approximately $23,000 to $27,000 for a limited-scope Vancouver project and climbs past $400,000 for a full luxury transformation. The biggest cost drivers are the number of rooms renovated, material quality, whether structural or plumbing work is involved, and the city's permit requirements.

What Determines the Cost of a Whole House Renovation in Vancouver?

The cost of a whole house renovation in Vancouver depends on four main factors. First, the scope of work — a project covering two bathrooms, a kitchen and flooring costs more than a single-room renovation. Second, material quality — custom millwork, natural stone countertops and premium fixtures add 30–50% compared to standard finishes. Third, structural and mechanical work — moving plumbing, rewiring or removing walls requires a Vancouver building permit and an engineer, adding $5,000–$15,000 or more. Fourth, neighbourhood and property type — a Vancouver Heritage home may require heritage reviews; a strata-titled condo may require neighbour consent and strata approval for external changes.

Does Vancouver Charge Permit Fees for Whole House Renovations?

Yes. Any whole house renovation in Vancouver that involves structural changes, plumbing relocation, electrical upgrades or changes to the building envelope requires a building permit from the City of Vancouver. Permit fees in Vancouver are calculated on the estimated construction value and typically range from $1,000 to $5,000 or more for a full whole-house project. Heritage-designated properties in Vancouver may also require heritage review, which adds time and potentially additional costs.

For a condo renovation in Vancouver, you may also need strata approval before beginning work — particularly for changes to exterior walls, plumbing stacks or anything affecting shared infrastructure. Frequently Asked Questions About Whole House Renovation Costs in Vancouver

What is the average cost of a whole house renovation in Vancouver in 2026?

The average cost of a whole house renovation in Vancouver ranges from $23,000 to over $90,000 in 2026, depending on scope. A limited-scope Vancouver whole-house renovation starts around $23,000–$27,000. A full premium project covering kitchen and multiple bathrooms — such as the Coal Harbour project at $85,000–$90,000 — represents the upper end for a condo-scale whole-house renovation.

Is it cheaper to renovate a house or buy a new one in Vancouver?

In Vancouver's current market, a whole house renovation typically costs 30–60% less than purchasing a comparable move-in-ready home. A $25,000–$90,000 renovation can transform an existing property into a modern home without the transaction costs of buying — which in Vancouver include the BC Property Transfer Tax and, for properties over $3 million, the additional federal luxury tax. Reno Stars provides itemized budgets before any work begins.

What is the most expensive part of a whole house renovation in Vancouver?

Kitchens are consistently the most expensive room to renovate in a Vancouver whole-house project, typically representing 25–35% of the total budget. A Vancouver kitchen renovation with custom cabinets and premium finishes ranges $29,000–$72,000. Bathrooms are the second most costly, ranging $14,000–$60,000 depending on scope and finish level.

How long does a whole house renovation take in Vancouver?

A limited-scope whole house renovation in Vancouver typically takes 3 to 6 weeks. A full kitchen-and-two-bathroom project — such as the Coal Harbour whole-house project — takes approximately 8 to 14 weeks from permit approval to final inspection. Vancouver's City of Vancouver permit queue can add 4 to 8 weeks to the overall timeline for projects requiring structural or plumbing permits.

Does renovating increase property value in Vancouver?

Yes. In Vancouver's real estate market, a well-executed whole house renovation typically returns 70–85% of the renovation cost in increased property value at resale, according to industry renovation value surveys. Kitchens and bathrooms offer the highest return on investment. A kitchen renovation at $35,000–$70,000 can add $30,000–$80,000 or more to a Vancouver home's assessed value, depending on the neighbourhood.

溫哥華整屋裝修費用明細（2026 年）

獨立屋或城市屋的整屋裝修費用取決於四個主要因素：工程範圍（多少個房間及哪些區域）、材料品質（標準裝修與定制櫃體的差異）、是否涉及結構或水管改動，以及是否需要申請建築許可證。溫哥華市政府的建築許可證費用根據工程估值計算，通常介乎 $1,000 至 $5,000 或以上。

廚房及浴室裝修費用參考

廚房是整屋裝修中最昂貴的部分，通常佔整個預算的 25% 至 35%。溫哥華廚房裝修費用由 $29,000（標準定制櫃）至 $70,000（溫哥華優質全廚房）。浴室裝修費用則由 $14,000（標準淋浴改造）至 $57,000（豪華雙浴室連定制櫃體）。

  • 廚房：$29,000 – $72,000，取決於櫃體材質及面積
  • 浴室（標準）：$14,000 – $17,000
  • 浴室（中檔）：$28,000 – $35,000
  • 浴室（豪華）：$40,000 – $60,000，含無障礙淋浴、定制瓷磚及高級五金

許可證及監管要求

溫哥華市規定，涉及結構改動、水管移動或電路升級的工程必須向市政府申請建築許可證，費用視工程估值而定。 Heritage 住宅可能需要額外的 Heritage 審查。三在城市屋或柏文施工可能需要業主立案法團（strata）批准。聚星裝修代办許可證申請及驗收流程。

常見問題

溫哥華整屋裝修平均費用是多少？

溫哥華整屋裝修平均費用介乎 $23,000 至 $90,000 以上，具體取決於工程範圍。一個有限範圍的整屋裝修起價約 $23,000；一個涵蓋廚房及多個浴室的豪華項目造價可達 $85,000 至 $90,000。

裝修週期需要多久？

有限範圍的整屋裝修通常需時 3 至 6 週。涵蓋廚房及兩個浴室的完整項目約需 8 至 14 週。溫哥華市政府的許可證審批流程約需 4 至 8 週。
